summary.zh: 为幻灯片挑选并摆放合适的图标、图片和图示
summary.en: Pick and place icons, images, and diagrams in slides

description.zh: 按页面要表达的信息选择图标、图片、SVG 或示意图，确认来源与使用授权后按指定尺寸摆放，并补上替代文本。只在配图能帮助理解时使用，关键文字仍保留为可编辑对象。
description.en: Selects icons, images, SVGs, and diagrams that support the message, then places them at explicit sizes with alt text and recorded sources. Use it when a slide needs visuals without flattening key content.
